## PresenceRequirementOptions.requirePresencePerUse property

Require the active backend to force a fresh, per-use human presence action for this operation. Defaults to `false` (no presence requirement).

**Signature:**

```typescript
requirePresencePerUse?: boolean | undefined;
```
